# Find All Occurrences of a Collection of Patterns in a String - Assembly Solution

I'll solve this Rosalind problem using assembly language. This problem requires finding all occurrences of multiple patterns within a given string.

## Problem Understanding

Given:
- A DNA string `s` of length at most 1000
- A collection of patterns (substrings) of length at most 10

We need to find all starting positions (0-indexed) where each pattern occurs in the string.

## Assembly Implementation

```assembly
.section .data
    # Input string and patterns
    dna_string: .ascii "
